reconcile.note: Henry places the paradise Jesus promised in Hades, the realm of separated souls, distinct from the Father's heaven not yet entered until the ascension.

discrepancy.note: Ingersoll presses the timing clash: Luke has Christ ascend the very day of the resurrection, while John still has him unascended and appearing days later.

quotes.text: Luke testifies that Christ ascended on the very day of his resurrection. John deposes that eight days after the resurrection Christ appeared to the disciples and convinced Thomas. In the Acts we are told that Christ remained on earth for forty days after his resurrection. These "depositions" do not agree.
quotes.attr: Robert G. Ingersoll (d. 1899), The Christian Religion, pt. III (Rejoinder to Judge Black) (1881), on Luke 23:43 and John 20:17.

sides.snippet: today you will be with me in Paradise
sides.verseText: Jesus said to him, \"Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.\"

sides.snippet: I haven't yet ascended to my Father
sides.verseText: Jesus said to her, \"Don't touch me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'\"
